Auth: all endpoints reject unauthenticated calls (401/403).

The fix applied (DELETE route reorder) is the only backend change in this iteration. Frontend regression should focus on i18n key completion if main agent adds those translations.
rca of the issue: DELETE /api/studio-library/by-entity returned 500 'invalid input syntax for type uuid: "by-entity"'. Root cause: in FastAPI, @router.delete('/{item_id}') was registered BEFORE @router.delete('/by-entity') in studio_library.py, so the dynamic route greedily matched 'by-entity' as the item_id parameter and tried to query the DB with that string. Mitigation: declared the static '/by-entity' route before the dynamic '/{item_id}' route. Verified via pytest and confirmed test_save_brand_then_idempotent and the by-entity cleanup now pass cleanly.
